name: WhatsApp (WAHA)
description: DEPRECATED: WhatsApp is now built into Floq (Settings > Integrations); update Floq, your chats, accounts and settings carry over. This plugin gets no further updates. It was: WhatsApp in Floq on your own WAHA instance, with several accounts, history import, media, groups and AI access with approvals.

secrets.name: WAHA_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key of your WAHA instance (sent as X-Api-Key)

secrets.name: WAHA_WEBHOOK_HMAC
secrets.description: HMAC key configured in WAHA for webhooks. When set, every webhook is verified.

settings.label: WAHA address
settings.description: Where your WAHA instance listens, for example https://waha.example.com. Only this address is ever contacted.

settings.label: First session
settings.description: WAHA session of the first account, read once. Defaults to "default". Add, attach and remove accounts from the account menu of the inbox.

settings.label: History: messages per chat
settings.description: How many of the newest messages of each chat the history import brings in. Default 1000.

settings.label: History: messages per import
settings.description: Upper limit of one history import over all chats of an account. Default 50000. Media files are not downloaded by the import, only on demand.

settings.label: Let the AI message me freely
settings.description: On by default once your number is saved below. The AI can then send you any message on WhatsApp, no approval needed. It only ever writes to your own number.

settings.label: Always allow AI to send messages
settings.description: WARNING: when on, agents send WhatsApp messages to ANY chat as your account without asking you first, and a message cannot be unsent. Off by default: each message then needs your approval in Floq. Turn on only if you accept that risk.
